file(GLOB SPINDLE_LUA_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.c)
add_library(spindle_lua STATIC ${SPINDLE_LUA_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(spindle_lua SYSTEM PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src)
set_target_properties(spindle_lua PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 99 POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(spindle_lua PRIVATE /W0)
else()
  target_compile_options(spindle_lua PRIVATE -w)
  if(IOS)
    target_compile_definitions(spindle_lua PRIVATE LUA_USE_IOS) # POSIX without system(), which iOS lacks
  elseif(NOT WIN32)
    target_compile_definitions(spindle_lua PRIVATE LUA_USE_POSIX)
  endif()
endif()
